title: Master of Imlers (1449)
problem: The count leaves out the attacker: bc_GetAlliesOf(source, false, false). So each attacker gets 20% per other Imler / Imling (2 of them: +20% instead of +40%; 6: +100% instead of +120%). The sibling Masters (Gorgons, Doom Fortresses, Carvers) include the attacker.
notes: Community claim: The bonus seems to be 10% per Imler/Imling, not 20%. Evidence: bc_EventDamage L3578-L3587: gates @0x140e56cc5 / 0x140e56ec5; bc_GetAlliesOf @0x140e5715d with both flags 0x1498e0f40 (false) loaded @0x140e5708c / 0x140e570e3; race tests @0x140e572ac / 0x140e5735c; × 0.2 @0x140e57419. Fix sketch: Repoint the include-self argument (lea rdx @0x140e570e3) from 0x1498e0f40 to 0x1498e0f60 (K). Triage 2026-10-26: K: include-self argument @0x140e570e3 from 0x1498e0f40 (false) to 0x1498e0f60 (true), as the sibling Masters do. 2026-10-26: built as byte patch SU-0168 (verified against the baseline exe; not yet run in game).

release_notes.intended: Your Imlers and Imlings deal 20% more damage for each Imler and Imling on your side.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the attacker didn't count itself.
